statements.status_notes: quinn-proto 0.11.18 fixes this advisory. The bundled copy ships inside py-rattler 0.26.0, which is the newest build installable with conda-rattler-solver 0.2.0 (that solver requires py-rattler below 0.27.0). py-rattler 0.27.0 is published on conda-forge but cannot be installed until a newer conda-rattler-solver release allows it.
